facts.fact: The Acting Principal Secretary of the ICT ministry stated that Government has designated the Lesotho Communications Authority as the interim Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), ahead of the Cybersecurity Bill; no designation date is given, so the 23 September 2026 publication date is used.
facts.system: Lesotho Communications Authority as interim CSIRT
